source_text: Severe acute complications, such as significant penile injury or partial amputation, are exceedingly rare, with incidence rates estimated at 0.04% for penile injury and lower for amputation, on the order of 1 in 500,000 to 1 million circumcisions in hospital settings. [38] [14]
